notes.title: Small update regarding obtaining the "Portal" achievement
notes.content:
After some time, I have accumulated a certain number of requests regarding the achievement of the "Portal" achievement. The fact is that it was difficult for some players to get it, so I decided to make it a little easier to get it! Plus, a pleasant surprise awaits you as an additional achievement!

For this I need to thank the player Priscilla, who helped me understand that the problem really exists.

Good luck and pleasant game!

https://youtu.be/xcmyBifuMO4
